bio: Nestled in the heart of the Scottish highlands, The Airds Hotel & Restaurant is a luxury boutique hotel, and converted ferry inn, on the west coast of Scotland.  You can enjoy a delicious Afternoon Tea in the hotels beautiful restaurant which has been awarded 3 AA Rosettes.  This exclusive retreat offers sensational views across Port Appin, providing a unique setting for Afternoon Tea in Scotland.  At the Airds they take 'Afternoon Tea' very seriously not only in terms of the actual food they serve but also in relation to the range of teas they offer.  The full afternoon tea selection includes a variety of handmade sandwiches complemented by home baked warm scones with home-made jams and clotted cream, and cakes and biscuits. There is also a wide selection of teas, or for true decadence, why not treat yourself to a glass of champagne.
